findings.text: The test's docstring ("still refuses, as it did before") and its name ("..._as_before") describe a preserved behaviour that never existed: the run's own base arm arms/node-tests-at-base.log shows the base accepted this recording at exit 0 with suite_delta status not-run, so the no-gate refusal is new, not preserved. The node's evidence fragment states this correctly, but the test a future reader opens first still claims the opposite.

No assertion covers the path the change newly reaches: an armed hand-merged run that cites no gate and whose recorded arms both completed now falls through to suite-evidence evaluation instead of returning not-run, so a regression that refused or misread such a legitimate recording would leave all three tests green.

The done_when clause "the CLI help-contract tests pass with the new options listed" is only half-evidenced: test_every_crew_verb_help_names_its_state asserts each verb's state phrase in its help text, and asserts nothing about the four new options appearing in record-merge --help, so the clause rests on the test passing rather than on any assertion about the options.
